en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a stone arched bridge crossing a calm, tree‑lined lake or canal. The bridge has multiple semicircular arches and a railing along the top, with trees and foliage reflected in the water. A shaded path runs along the right side of the image. Printed red text in French appears along the bottom margin, identifying the view and the publisher.
